reached_sql: SELECT it.i_item_id, r.ca_country, r.ca_state, r.ca_county, r.agg1, r.agg2, r.agg3, r.agg4, r.agg5, r.agg6, r.agg7 FROM (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, ca.ca_country AS ca_country, ca.ca_state AS ca_state, ca.ca_county AS ca_county, AVG(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg1, AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg2, AVG(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg3, AVG(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg4, AVG(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg5, AVG(CAST(c.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg6, AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg7 FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 2001 JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4) AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA') GROUP BY ROLLUP (cs.cs_item_sk, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county)) AS r LEFT JOIN item it ON it.i_item_sk = r.item_sk ORDER BY r.ca_country, r.ca_state, r.ca_county, it.i_item_id LIMIT 100
